newsitem.title: PERU: Tension hits fever pitch outside Peru residence.
newsitem.headline: Tension hits fever pitch outside Peru residence.

text.p: Several large buses suddenly pulled up outside the besieged Japanese embassy residence on Sunday and top negotiators arrived on the scene of a six-day hostage-taking ordeal.

Amid unconfirmed local media speculation that a major development was imminent, chief Peruvian government negotiator Domingo Palermo arrived on the scene for the first time since the hostages were taken last Tuesday night.
Top Red Cross mediator Michel Minnig was preparing to enter the residence, where Marxist rebels were holding around 340 hostages.
Crack police teams and firemen stood by under the gaze of hordes of waiting newsmen.
There was no official information about what was happening.
No major developments have come at the residence since a group of 38 hostages were released Friday night.
